lemmas.primary_translation: know what one needs to know

definitions.text: om eldre forhold: kunne læresetningene i katekisme og dermed kunne bli konfirmert
definitions.translation: under older conditions: know the tenets of the catechism and thereby be able to be confirmed (lit. know one's catechism)

definitions.text: kunne eller vite tingene en trenger
definitions.translation: know or understand the things one needs

examples.no: for å bli en god leder må du kunne din katekisme
examples.en: to become a good leader, you have to know your stuff
